messages:
vince: Quick sync — AcmeCloud wants a VPC/on‑prem POC. They're asking to defer the platform fee for the first 3 months and run on Standard support during the trial. They'll commit to a 12mo reserved capacity if POC meets performance targets. Also: outstanding security questionnaire items around KMS/HSM and telemetry retention. Can we structure credits/fees to keep legal/finance happy?

alex: clarifying q — are they requesting full waiver or just delay/credit? Customer says 0 platform fee for POC in writing.

leah: tech note — for a POC we can restrict telemetry and enable BYOK for KMS. HSM-backed keys for onprem are doable but requires enterprise plan and extra onboarding time. Lowering support to Standard shortens oncall windows; any SRE onboarding time will likely be PS line item.

jamie: finance: we avoid invoice exceptions. Prefer offering bill credits or a structured ramp rather than changing platform fee line on contract. Need ARR forecast and PO cadence to model cashflow hit.

kevin: deal desk: can approve a partial credit (eg 50% platform fee months 1–3) if AE secures a commit threshold (min monthly commit). Full 100% waiver needs director-level approval + legal signoff. Share expected $ amounts and commit profile.

alex: customer pushing hard for zero. Would credits + a short invoice hold get them across the line? They want minimal friction for procurement.

sarah: legal: credits are preferable to changing invoicing terms. We'll require a short addendum documenting the credit schedule, telemetry limits, and explicit exclusions (no warranty change). Also need confirmation on data retention config — PII must be excluded from logs.

leah: confirm we can set retention to 90 days and exclude PII via our telemetry toggle. Example config snippet we can apply for the POC:
```
telemetry: 
  enabled: true
  retention_days: 90
  pii_scrub: true
```
BYOK for keys supported; full HSM-managed keys require the enterprise security add-on.

vince: Proposed offer to AcmeCloud: 50% platform fee credit months 1–3, Standard support during POC, option to upgrade support within 30 days of commit, 12mo commit floor $[AE_FILL], telemetry retention capped at 90d with PII scrubbing, BYOK allowed (no HSM). Include security questionnaire responses and PS estimate for onboarding. Kevin — can you route this to director for sign-off?

kevin: I will draft the deal desk note. Need AE to provide expected ARR and target PO window (net30/net45) + security questionnaire ID. Once I have numbers I can route to Director -> Finance -> Legal.

alex: will drop ARR, PO window, and the security questionnaire link into this thread by EOD.

deal-desk-bot: deal-desk-bot: Routing created: 2101234567_acmecloud_credit-request -> director-ops, finance, legal. Status: pending approval.

jamie: finance: prelim sign-off on the credit structure, conditional on receiving forecast and no change to core contract language. We'll accept credits applied as contra-revenue line.

sarah: legal: once AE posts the questionnaire link and we verify telemetry config, we'll prepare the addendum. No special indemnities; keep SLAs standard.

vince: awesome — thanks team :thumbsup: tagging @director-ops for final ok. If director approves, we can present offer to Acme tomorrow.

director-ops: director-ops: Reviewed the ask. Approve 50% platform credit months 1–3 tied to the documented 12mo commit floor and telemetry constraints. Routing signatures: Finance/Jamie OK, Legal/Sarah to finalize addendum. Please attach the forecast and PS estimate before I sign the addendum.

vince: copy — I'll assemble the docs now and loop in AE + SE for customer call.

alex: sending forecast + questionnaire link now.

leah: prepping the POC env checklist and PS estimate (ETA 2 business days).

vince: thanks all — moving to execution.
